S.FORM: alang Kuxan ga niya mki sku Sincik Keng atu Nahuy go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 51 buwan, 142 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 94% kyan ku 133 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 6% kyan ku 9 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Tayan 90%, binah lihuyan s'uli 4%. maki qu ngasal bziran. qalang Kuxan ga ungat kyokay. qalang Kuxan ga ungat hasisyo. alang Kuxan ga ungat ngasal sexu. qalang Kuxan ga ungat khu skwan biru.qalang Kuxan ga ungat ngasal pkita nbu. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Kuxan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay 'zil na Kuxan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkyahu' na Kuxan hya' ga rgyax krahu'. tay mkraya' na Kuxan hya' ga llyung. qalang Kuxan ga ungat pqwasan biru. tay mkyahu' na Kuxan hya' ga Ageq. tay 'zil na Kuxan hya' ga Cinbulan. rekisi kayal qmisan lga, hzyaq balay maki' te rgyax hiya'. kyokay ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan pqwasan biru 'laqi' cikuy pqwasan biru 'laqi' mrkyas tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ kuxan ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku [s|ɕ]in[ʦ|ʨ]ik keŋ atu naħuj ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku *** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa * kjan ku * ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa tajan ** βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran qalaŋ kuxan ɣa uŋat kjokaj qalaŋ kuxan ɣa uŋat ħa[s|ɕ]i[s|ɕ]jo alaŋ kuxan ɣa uŋat ŋa[s|ɕ]al [s|ɕ]exu qalaŋ kuxan ɣa uŋat kħu [s|ɕ]kwan βiruqalaŋ kuxan ɣa uŋat ŋa[s|ɕ]al pkita nβu rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na kuxan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj ʔzil na kuxan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkjaħuʔ na kuxan ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax kraħuʔ taj mkrajaʔ na kuxan ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ qalaŋ kuxan ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru taj mkjaħuʔ na kuxan ħjaʔ ɣa aɣeq taj ʔzil na kuxan ħjaʔ ɣa [ʦ|ʨ]inβulan reki[s|ɕ]i kajal qmi[s|ɕ]an lɣa ħzjaq βalaj makiʔ te rɣjax ħijaʔ kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ [ʦ|ʨ]ikuj pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru ʔlaqiʔ mrkja[s|ɕ] tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
